note: Post-review verification of product defects the reviewers reported, and of a harness capture-timing defect. Nothing here changes a frozen judgment; it records what the lead independently verified after unblinding.

harnessDefect.what: The freight success capture fired while the page was still transitioning, so no freight "success" render showed the settled recorded state. Both reviewers reported this independently.
harnessDefect.cause: The capture ran immediately after the retry click rather than after the recorded surface had settled.
harnessDefect.fix: Acceptance now waits for the honest disclaimer, the recorded decision, absence of any visible failure alert, and absence of "Submitting", then captures.
harnessDefect.explanation: Only the capture timing changed. Assertion counts, sources and axe results are identical between initial-01 and initial-02, so the frozen judgments remain valid for the same pages.

verifiedProductDefects.claim: The "Clear search and filter" control is visible and operative at first load although nothing is filtered yet, because .btn{display:inline-flex} overrides the [hidden] UA rule.
verifiedProductDefects.how: Read the entry-state capture at 1440 (evidence/archive-R1/initial-01/1440-entry) and the source rules.
verifiedProductDefects.sourceEvidence: .btn{display:inline-flex;...} is declared after the UA [hidden] rule applies, and the element carries the hidden attribute, so it still lays out.
verifiedProductDefects.severity: task-quality/affordance defect; does not break the slice

verifiedProductDefects.claim: resetAll("empty") focuses an h3 that renderList() has just re-hidden.
verifiedProductDefects.how: The cell source documents this exact class of failure in its own comment about a hidden subtree ignoring focus; the call order was read directly.
verifiedProductDefects.result: supported by source; not separately reproduced as a rendered assertion
